title.en: What persisting shows of an order

statement.en: Where a choice ending what a line depends on is realized as an overdraw, a persisting line whose choices come from some strict order has them consistent with keeping ranked above ending on the occasions met, and with self-concern there where only ending was at stake.
statement.zh: 终结系之所依之择实现为透支处，其择出于某严序之存续之系，其择与于所遇之时存居终上相合，于唯终结攸关处与自我关切相合。

laws.en: Choices with required comparisons: a relation's pairs read as further occasions; some strict order accords with the choices and makes every required comparison exactly where the shown relation with them added has no cycle; every such order shares exactly that relation's reach, and beyond it some ranks either way.
laws.zh: 附所求比较之诸择：一关系之诸对读作更多之择时；有严序与诸择相合且作每一所求比较，恰当增之后所示之关系无环；每一此序所共有者恰为此关系之及，及外有序两向排之。

laws.en: Where the choices come from some strict order and no chosen alternative ends, what ends is a sink: some strict order according with the choices puts every alternative that does not end above every one that ends and was open with it.
laws.zh: 诸择出于某严序且无所择者终结处，终者为汇：有与诸择相合之严序，置每一不终者于每一与之同开而终者之上。

laws.en: An order increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met together: some strict order according with the choices is so exactly where the shown relation with every own-widening met added has no cycle; where the choices come from a strict order, no chosen course ends and only ending is at stake on the occasions met, as where each course open keeps all or none of the own continuation, some is.
laws.zh: 于同遇之对上随己之延续而增之序：有与诸择相合之严序如此，恰当增入每一所遇之己扩大后所示之关系无环；诸择出于某严序、无所择之程终结且于所遇之时唯终结攸关处（如每一开者或全存或全无己之延续），有之。

laws.en: Off the occasions met it is free: where some such order exists and a course met nowhere widens another and adds to the own continuation, some strict order according with the choices and increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met ranks the other above it, and so is not increasing in its own continuation.
laws.zh: 所遇之时外则自由：有此序且一未遇之程扩大另一程并增己之延续处，有与诸择相合、于所遇之对上随己之延续而增之严序置另一程于其上，故非随己之延续而增。

laws.en: Every course met: in a witness of two occasions, each choosing a course that a course open at the other widens while adding to the own continuation, each of the four courses is open somewhere and no choice ends, yet no strict order according with the choices is increasing in its own continuation.
laws.zh: 诸程皆遇：二时之例，各择一程，而彼时所开之一程扩大之并增己之延续；四程各于某时开，无择终结，然无与诸择相合之严序随己之延续而增。

laws.en: The course taken is never a listed level path: under only active formations giving, activity needing support and descent, where a line persists the web's actual levels admit some formation at arbitrarily late steps, so no finite listing holds what they admit, and an order ranking listed level paths never ranks the course actually taken.
laws.zh: 所行之程永非所列之层路径：唯活跃者给、活跃需支持、传代之下，有系存续处，网之实际层级于任意晚之步纳某形成，故无有限列举持其所纳；排所列层路径之序永不排实际所行之程。

laws.en: On the World, under balance, only active formations giving and activity needing support, with a family's renewal gated on it and every member of every cohort depending on it, each at a need of at least m, a line with members in arbitrarily late cohorts never had the family's uptake exceed its replenishment for n steps from a stock below n + m.
laws.zh: 于世界模型，平衡、唯活跃者给、活跃需支持，族之更新受其门控，每一世代之每一成员依于此族，需各至少 m：成员见于任意晚之世代之系，从未自少于 n + m 之存量起连 n 步令族之取用超其补充。

laws.en: Where a chosen course ending what the line depends on is realized as such an overdraw, a persisting line's choices, coming from some strict order, are consistent with keeping ranked above ending, and with an order increasing in its own continuation on the occasions met wherever only ending was at stake there.
laws.zh: 所择之程终结系之所依者实现为此透支处，存续之系之择（出于某严序）与存居终上相合，并与于所遇之时随己之延续而增之序相合，凡彼处唯终结攸关者。

laws.en: Witness, the stake cannot be dropped: a line of one member a step on a commons meets every World law named and persists; choosing the line as it is over one more child and an ending, a choice according with a stipulated strict order, it never ends, keeping stands above ending, and no strict order according with its choice is increasing in its own continuation on the occasion met.
laws.zh: 例，攸关之设不可去：一共有物上每步一成员之系，满足所列世界之律而存续；于多一子、如其所是与终结之间择如其所是（此择合于一所设之严序），从不终结，存者居终者之上，而无与其择相合之严序于所遇之时随己之延续而增。

hypotheses.en: Any carrier of alternatives and any occasions; choices accord by strict dominance; that they come from some strict order, nothing shown returning, is a hypothesis.
hypotheses.zh: 任一备择之载体与任一时；诸择以严胜相合；其出于某严序（所示无返）为假设。

hypotheses.en: Courses are two-valued admissions on a finite listing; the own continuation is a marking of listed items; ending is any predicate on alternatives, read as ending what the chooser depends on, or admitting no marked item.
hypotheses.zh: 程为有限列举上之二值接纳；己之延续为所列项之标记；终结为备择上之任一谓词，读作终结择者之所依者，或不纳任何所标之项。

hypotheses.en: On the World: balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, a family's renewal gated on it and every cohort depending on it, each at a need of at least m.
hypotheses.zh: 于世界模型：平衡、唯活跃者给、活跃需支持、传代、族之更新受其门控、每一世代依于此族，需各至少 m。

hypotheses.en: The link to the flow, supplied: a chosen course ending what the line depends on is realized as an overdraw of the family from a short stock.
hypotheses.zh: 与流之联系，为所设：所择之程终结系之所依者，实现为自不足之存量对族之透支。

hypotheses.en: The stake, for the positive law: on the occasions met, a course adds to the own continuation beyond one it widens only where it does not end and the other does.
hypotheses.zh: 攸关之设（正律所需）：于所遇之时，一程超其所扩大者而增己之延续，唯以不终而彼终。

does_not_show.en: That any order is held: the choices are consistent with one, which does not show that the chooser carries it.
does_not_show.zh: 任一序为所持：诸择与之相合，不示择者携之。

does_not_show.en: Anything between degrees of keeping: in the witness, a persisting line choosing fewer of its own over more is consistent with no strict order increasing in its own continuation on the occasion met.
does_not_show.zh: 存之程度之间之任何事：例中，存续之系择己之少者于多者之上，与任何于所遇之时随己之延续而增之严序皆不合。

does_not_show.en: Self-concern beyond the pairs met together, even with every course met.
does_not_show.zh: 同遇之对以外之自我关切，即使诸程皆遇。

does_not_show.en: That a chosen ending is realized as an overdraw, or that actual formations choose by a strict order among such courses.
does_not_show.zh: 所择之终结实现为透支，或实际之形成于此类程间依严序而择。

does_not_show.en: Selection by share among several lines: persisting here is members in arbitrarily late cohorts, with no rate or fitness.
does_not_show.zh: 多系间依份额之选择：此处之存续为任意晚世代有成员，无速率或适应度。

detail.en: A line of one member a step on a commons, meeting the World laws and persisting, chooses the line as it is over one more child, a choice according with a stipulated strict order: no strict order according with its choice is increasing in its own continuation on the occasion met (PersistingChoices.Forgoing.persists_not_selfConcerned). The choice is tied to the flow only by the realization premise, which holds vacuously.
detail.zh: 共有物上每步一成员之系，满足世界之律而存续，择如其所是于多一子之上（此择合于一所设之严序）：无与其择相合之严序于所遇之时随己之延续而增（PersistingChoices.Forgoing.persists_not_selfConcerned）。此择唯以实现之前提系于流，而此前提空真。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty; a leaf importing Weightings, MutualDependence and ShownOrder, checked by the core run named in the references. Written by an AI and checked against the Lean by its author; no person's review recorded. Short laws, none new as mathematics. The choice laws are ShownOrder's on enlarged occasions; the survivorship law is the coupled ending of GroupEnding read contrapositively; the witness evaluates its tables by rfl and Nat.beq lemmas proved by recursion.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空；叶模块，引 Weightings、MutualDependence 与 ShownOrder，经参考所列之核运行检查。AI 所写，作者对照 Lean 自查；尚无人之审查记录。诸律皆短，无新数学。 择之律为 ShownOrder 于扩充之择时上之律；存续之律为 GroupEnding 之耦合终结之逆否；例以 rfl 及以递归所证之 Nat.beq 引理计算其表。

next_delta.en: Alternatives that are flows, so that what a chosen course does to the line is a law and not a premise; several lines under selection by share, to ask whether differential persistence fixes anything between degrees of keeping; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 备择为流，使所择之程于系所为者为律而非前提；多系依份额而择，以问差异之存续是否定存之程度之间之任何事；人之审查。

correspondence.en: Rationalizing strict choices by a strict partial order with required comparisons added, near Richter (1966); keeping above ending is survivorship read in that form. AI reading: read with training and selection, what persisting installs is fixed on the occasions met, which locates goal misgeneralization (Langosco and others 2022; Shah and others 2022) as a possibility, not shown; the witness is a weaker form of the countermodel an AI reading proposed (a persisting, fully informed, internally implemented chooser that is not self-concerned): here nothing represents information and the chooser is not implemented in the flow. These are readings, not containments.
correspondence.zh: 以严偏序合理化附所求比较之严择，近于 Richter（1966）；存居终上为以此形读之幸存者偏差。AI 解读：与训练及选择并读，存续所装者定于所遇之时，故目标误泛化（Langosco 等 2022；Shah 等 2022）为确定其处之可能，非所示；例为一 AI 之读所提之反模型（存续、全知、内建于流而非自我关切之择者）之较弱形：此处无物表示所知，择者未建于流中。此皆解读，非包含。

detail.en: Occasions of choosing and their laws, applied to the enlarged occasions (ChoiceOccasions, Shown, Accords, accorded_iff_noCycle, above_in_every_iff_reach, above_in_some_of_unreached).
detail.zh: 择之时及其律，用于扩充之择时（ChoiceOccasions、Shown、Accords、accorded_iff_noCycle、above_in_every_iff_reach、above_in_some_of_unreached）。

detail.en: Orders increasing in their own continuation on a listing (Weighting.IncreasingInOwn, WidensOn, AddsOwn) and the coupled ending under which no later cohort has a member (GroupEnding.Flow.family_childless).
detail.zh: 列举上随己之延续而增之序（Weighting.IncreasingInOwn、WidensOn、AddsOwn），及无后世代有成员之耦合终结（GroupEnding.Flow.family_childless）。

detail.en: AI reading: off the occasions met the order is free, as a trained response is free where unlumped.
detail.zh: AI 解读：所遇之时外其序自由，如已训之应于未归并处自由。

detail.en: The same landing: scope where everything is entangled.
detail.zh: 同次落地：万物相缠处之范围。

history.en: 9 November 2026, board item ZA (Ren, 9 November 2026: how far the zero-axiom target is, after "ethics emerges from continuation condition, not another way around"): added. G3 of the readings: choice modelled beside a flow, tied to it by the realization premise; both halves proved, with a witness of a persisting chooser that is not self-concerned, showing the stake premise cannot be dropped; said as "consistent with", not "has". One AI reader read the texts against the Lean; its findings (a witness stated as a law, a missing strict-order premise, "of its own" and "fully informed" overclaimed) were taken. Route (b) of the zero-axiom reading, with ZA-G1, ZB and ZC; G2 went to ZC.
history.zh: 2026年11月9日，工作板条目 ZA（Ren 2026年11月9日问零公理目标尚有多远）：新增。诸读之 G3：于流旁建择之模型，以实现之前提系于流；两半皆证，附存续而非自我关切之择者之例，示攸关之设不可去；言「相合」，不言「有」。一 AI 读者对照 Lean 读其文，所见（以例为律、缺严序之前提、「己之」与「全知」言过）皆已采纳。零公理之读之路 (b)，与 ZA-G1、ZB、ZC 并行；G2 归 ZC。

history.en: 9 November 2026, board item ZA, follow-up from three AI readings of route (b)'s join: the crossed witness (every course met, no strict order according with the choices increasing in its own continuation) and the persisting line's course never a listed level path were added; laws and a does-not-show line added, no earlier statement changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月9日，工作板条目 ZA，依路 (b) 合并之三 AI 之读之补：增交错之例（诸程皆遇而无与诸择相合之严序随己之延续而增）、存续之系所行之程永非所列之层路径；增律与一行「未表明」，先前陈述不改。

history.en: 9 November 2026, J1 (route (b)'s join, board rule 9): Weighting.IncreasingInOwnOn and its two laws moved to Weightings beside IncreasingInOwn; ChoiceOccasions.reach_first_step went for the grammar's «及之首步»; the ending step of Flow.persists_never_overdraws is GroupEnding.Flow.coupled_generation_childless; and ChoiceOccasions.selfConcerned_consistent_of_kept is now derived from keeping_above_ending through ChoiceOccasions.increasingInOwnOn_of_keeping (under the stake, keeping above ending is self-concern on the pairs met). The claim is unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年11月9日，J1（路线 (b) 之合观，看板规则 9）：Weighting.IncreasingInOwnOn 及其二律移至 Weightings，与 IncreasingInOwn 并列；ChoiceOccasions.reach_first_step 去之，用文法之 «及之首步»；Flow.persists_never_overdraws 之终结一步为 GroupEnding.Flow.coupled_generation_childless；ChoiceOccasions.selfConcerned_consistent_of_kept 今经 ChoiceOccasions.increasingInOwnOn_of_keeping 由 keeping_above_ending 推出（攸关之设下，存居终上即所遇之对之自我关切）。所陈未变。
